records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Zara,

Thanks for setting up Clearwater Labs on Wrenfield. If your team is more than one person, inviting them now tends to pay off -- Wrenfield is built around teammates working on shared tasks, not solo lists.

Let me know how the first week goes.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: 6 days in, onboarding call held [calendar:7451ba1a] and intro email sent [email:012a16c9], but no first project, no invite, no key milestone and zero tickets \u2014 silence after a call plus 8 days left suggests low but non-trivial odds of self-serve activation.

draft.subject: Following up after your onboarding call
draft.body:
Hi Zara,

Good to talk last week about getting Clearwater Labs set up. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, so creating that first project is usually the step that makes everything else click \u2014 the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. When you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Want me to walk through setting up your first project with you on a short call this week? Happy to work around your schedule.

Best,
Chidi
